description: Windows disk-space monitor that records free-space changes, storage growth, and the processes writing to disk.
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires administrator rights to $cmd"; break }
pre_uninstall: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires administrator rights to $cmd"; break }

script: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $uninstaller -PathType Leaf)) { throw "DiskDrift Inno Setup uninstaller was not found: $uninstaller" }
if ($process.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "DiskDrift uninstaller exited with code $($process.ExitCode)." }
if ($null -ne $service) { throw 'DiskDrift service is still registered after the vendor uninstaller completed.' }
if ($null -ne $runEntry) { throw 'DiskDriftTray is still registered in the machine-wide Run key.' }

notes: Nonportable by design. Requires an elevated Scoop session. The official setup installs Collector and Tray under %ProgramFiles%\DiskDrift, registers the LocalSystem DiskDrift service, and adds a machine-wide tray startup entry. The uninstaller removes the service and tray registration but keeps history and logs under %ProgramData%\DiskDrift. The setup's protected Program Files location is intentional; do not override it with /DIR=$dir because the service runs as LocalSystem.
